title: Geneva Rising Revisited
author: Noor Eriksen
blurb: Yara Almeida, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
